caption:
How can we unlock the financing needed for a just and inclusive energy transition that leaves no one behind?
 
Global clean energy investment reached a record USD 2.1 trillion in 2024, reflecting strong momentum for change. Yet less than 15% reached developing economies outside China, and only 2% flowed to Africa continent. How can innovative finance, risk-sharing tools, and new partnerships direct capital where it is needed most?
 
Join UNDP and GEIDCO(Global Energy Interconnection Development and Cooperation Organization) at the 2025 Global Energy Interconnection Conference for a high-level dialogue on financing a just and inclusive energy transition - exploring how innovative financing mechanisms, de-risking approaches, and strategic cooperation can mobilize capital at scale and deliver lasting development impact for everyone, everywhere.
